FPLNSITE BUILDER
LOADING
LAPTOP · 1280 PXCLICK TO SELECT · CLICK TEXT AGAIN TO TYPE · ESC TO CANCEL

Ask AI to change the page

Describe what you want. The AI edits the page, the safety check runs, and you can undo it with one click.

Publish the launch page

  1. Save the page file. It's called site.json.
  2. Upload it to GitHub (sign in if asked).
    Open the upload page ↗
    Drag site.json onto the page, then click Commit changes. If you copied instead, open site.json on GitHub, press Ctrl+A, Ctrl+V and commit.
  3. Done. GitHub runs the safety check and the live page updates in about a minute.

Choose a picture

Use one of FPLN's pictures, or upload your own (it's shrunk to fit and checked).

Load a page file

Paste the contents of a site.json (for example, from GitHub) to load it into the builder.
